纸上战斗说是 韩国的Jungle Game Lab（丛林游戏实验室）出品的免费游戏，在该平台上推出了不少精品免费小游戏。（其本质上属于Krafton（前身即为蓝洞）对游戏初级开发者的培训计划）。 游戏则是结合了折纸谜题的回合制肉鸽，通过折纸改变自己与敌人的位置、攻击轨迹，最终消灭敌人赢得战斗。难度不大上手很容易，通关也很简单：虽然主角是脆皮随便一个怪摸一下就死，但容错率很大，初始给了五张纸复原（五次复活机会），除非运气不好敌人站位过于刁钻导致躲无可躲，基本上不带buff都能靠慢慢磨死敌人通关。 游戏内容则偏少——总共两大关俩Boss，可选人物只有俩（直线贯穿攻击的射手&以自身为半径攻击的战士），可以选择的小石（强化Buff）也不多，基本上多开几把能用俩人物各通关一次且遇到所有Buff。且传说石子过于强，战士同时带神速（速度+7）+巨人之眼（攻击范围×2）+最终武器（攻击×2）+幻影（命中召唤一个分身），攻击范围覆盖半张纸&先手&伤害逆天&分身补刀，直接判你赢算了。 刷传说石子拿成就的小技巧：[spoiler]进入商店发现没有传说石子，直接点exit game退出游戏，然后再进入，商店商品会刷新直到刷出你需要的石子[/spoiler]

A rogue-lite which doesn't innovate much except for their unique "combat" game loop. The folding mechanic makes intuitive sense and is easy to pick up but i found the mouse controls for releasing the paper a bit unreliably and could work around that with a touch screen. Being unable to unfold thing probably simplified the programming but it also adds an interesting challange of making the area ever smaller. The mechanic is rich enough to allow for different play styles but it does require some more balancing. The interaction of multiple pebbles isn't explained and i am sometimes suprised by the result, atleast from the english description. Better tutorializing of the exact mechanics of running out of pebble slots is also needed. I just discovered that there is a second character to unlock, this is not clearly communicated by the game design and only learned that because i was trying to look up what the "relics" were called. This could be better communicated via UI design as i was suprised by that. This is perfectly serviceable as a small distraction.
